summary: Replies to stream-routed messages now settle their parent in the messages shard instead of failing with an absent-to-closed lifecycle error after recording the reply. Repeating the same send key returns the existing reply and completes any remaining parent steps.

replay.detail: No replay or backfill. Existing graph-backed parents retain their claim-based settlement.

rules.detail: Reply settlement uses the same shard-writer lifecycle validation and idempotent steps as explicit stream read and archive. An already-closed parent requires no further settlement.

recovery.detail: A same-key retry of a reply previously recorded before a settlement error reuses the reply and settles the parent without another send.
